name: Powerful Lineage
body:
The divine powers gained by your deific parent flow strongly.

Prerequisite: Lineage domain class ability

Benefit: When calculating your effective cleric level for your lineage domains, you may use your whole class level, rather than just your godling levels, to a maximum of double your godling levels.
